body.text: I wrote to you before about the accounts. I write now in a different spirit.

The colony's returns are {perception:purse} and the Crown is {param:amount} out on your word. That is no longer a shortfall. It is a position, and positions of this kind are discussed at a level well above mine.
I am not able to go on presenting these figures as a temporary matter. I have done it twice and I will not do it a third time.
Raise the duties. I have said so before in a tone you may have found tiresome; I say it now in one I hope you find harder to set aside.
